claims.text: Nothing is scored before the freeze and the seal: no held-out inscription is revealed to the scoring path, and no scoring-path code runs on development data for this study, before the freeze record is committed and the Stage 1 seal record (held-out count and SHA-256 only) is committed; the held-out list is released to the scoring path exactly once, at scoring, and that release is recorded. This does not establish: that the held-out material is pristine against the candidates' historical derivation; that is C098-6's separate, capped question.

evidence.description: The freeze record records/freeze-v1-2026-11-21.md and spec section 3.3 (seal mechanism, following Specs 093/097 hash-pinned freeze practice).

falsification_tests: A scoring output, run-index entry, or development export dated before the seal record; a second release of the held-out list; or a seal hash at scoring time that does not recompute from the released list (which voids the run as SEAL FAILURE).

claims.text: Every scored sign faces the full frozen rival set under matched conditions: each sign's candidate is compared against rivals R-A (matched wrong Dravidian value), R-B (unrelated-family value), R-C (logogram), R-D (structural-only), and the model-level permutation R-E, constructed on development data only under WP8 fairness conditions (matched tuning budget, matched available evidence); Arm E signs additionally face the cross-sign and comparandum-as-value rivals named in the spec. This does not establish: that the rival set is exhaustive of all conceivable alternatives; it is the frozen, named set the audit's serious alternatives requires, and its limits are stated, not hidden.

claims.text: Success must be value-relevant: a sign can reach a pass outcome only on an accepted prediction sheet whose differing observables are value-relevant (neighbour identity or class, referent-distinguishing context, or a collocation on which phonetic and logogram rivals differ); success on language-neutral position or frequency alone, including beating the structural-only rival R-D, never suffices, and a sign with no accepted sheet is NOT IDENTIFIABLE by construction. This does not establish: that a borne-out value-relevant prediction proves the value; it is the frozen bar for discrimination, not a decipherment criterion.

evidence.description: Spec section 3.5 and the audit's Q5 item 2 (success on language-neutral position alone is insufficient).

falsification_tests: A pass outcome whose prediction sheet's only differing observable is position or frequency; or a scored sign with no prediction sheet in the pre-unsealing record.

claims.text: The decision rules are applied as frozen: each sign's outcome is the frozen vocabulary's, under the frozen precedence (UNDECIDABLE AT THIS POWER before NOT IDENTIFIABLE before the pass outcomes), the frozen bars (minimum 5 held-out tokens; penalized margin at least 10 nats; above the permutation null's 99th percentile, B = 999, seed 9801), and the frozen flexibility penalty of 2 nats per free choice, charged to candidates and rivals alike. This does not establish: that the bars are the uniquely right ones; they are the frozen ones, stated in advance so the study cannot be tuned to its results.

evidence.description: Spec section 4 and the freeze record; exercised by test case TC-098-02.

falsification_tests: An outcome record whose per-sign outcome does not follow from its own margins, counts, and null under the stated rules; a bar, seed, or penalty in the outcome record absent from the freeze; or a family-level summary that is not counts of per-sign outcomes.

claims.text: Execution discipline: venue, index, payload verdicts: all execution runs on tower-compute in a fresh clone; every scoring attempt, including failures, appears in the run index; and every reported run verdict is the run's own payload verdict record, never a wrapper or transport state. This does not establish: that a complete index proves the runs were correct; it proves they are all on the record, which is what makes their correctness checkable.

evidence.description: Spec decision D-098-4 and Spec 089 run-scoped discipline.

falsification_tests: A run executed on the coordination VM or the mini-server; a run index with a gap against the frozen settings; or a reported verdict that is a wrapper state rather than the payload's own record.
